messages:
Aisha (new-hire): hi all — I'm Aisha, just joined the infra team. Trying to follow the kube onboarding doc but my kubectl only shows the default context
Aisha (new-hire): ran `kubectl config get-contexts` and only see 'minikube' locally. I need access to the team-recs-dev namespace in the shared cluster. who should I ping for RBAC / kubeconfig?
Aisha (new-hire): pasted error when trying to `kubectl get pods -n team-recs-dev`: `Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "system:anonymous" cannot list resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"team-recs-dev\"`
Marco (eng-infra): welcome! :wave: pinging Sam and Priya. Usually we create a service account and a kubeconfig for new hires on the team.
Marco (eng-infra): Aisha — can you confirm whether you followed the onboarding step to run the SSO helper? (`rbac-sso-setup`) or did you try direct kubeconfig merge?
Aisha (new-hire): I used the macOS quickstart steps in the docs, but I might have skipped the SSO step. The doc linked from the welcome email is a bit different. I have my AWS SSO session active.
Priya (devex): hi Aisha, welcome! We recently updated the onboarding flow. If AWS SSO is active you should run:
```
# fetch and merge the team kubeconfig
onboard-cli kube merge --team team-recs --env dev --out ~/.kube/config
kubectl config use-context redwood-team-recs-dev
kubectl config get-contexts
```
Priya (devex): If that still doesn't show the right context, Sam can grant you a service account token or we can provision an impersonation RBAC bind for temporary access.
Sam (sre): adding details: for permanent access we create a RoleBinding in team-recs-dev that binds the `devs` group to `edit` rights. For now I'll create a temporary service account and post a kubeconfig snippet.
Sam (sre): @Aisha can you confirm your GitHub handle (for the audit annotation) and that you only need namespace-scoped edit access?
Aisha (new-hire): GitHub: aisha-k. Yes, just edit in team-recs-dev for the first few weeks.
Sam (sre): OK — creating SA now.
onboard-bot: Reminder — if you're missing the SSO merge step, fill the quick access form: https://redwood.internal/onboard/kube-access (this helps auto-create the ticket)
Sam (sre): done. I made a SA `aisha-temp-sa` in team-recs-dev and created a kubeconfig at `/tmp/aisha-kubeconfig.yaml`. Please test with:
```
KUBECONFIG=/tmp/aisha-kubeconfig.yaml kubectl get pods -n team-recs-dev
```
Aisha (new-hire): tried it — working! I can list pods and port-forward. Thanks Sam :) :tada:
Aisha (new-hire): one follow-up — who do I CC for a permanent RoleBinding request? Also how long is the temp SA valid?
Marco (eng-infra): CC `infra-access@redwood.com` and include your GitHub handle + justification. Sam, can infra approve a permanent `RoleBinding` for devs group or should Aisha request via the access form?
Sam (sre): infra approves, but we like the access form trace. I'll extend the temp SA for 48h. Create the access request (link above) and tag `Marco` and `Priya` in the request. We'll promote you to the `devs` group if everything looks good.
Priya (devex): FYI I've updated the onboarding quickstart to call out the SSO merge step and added the `KUBECONFIG` test snippet. I'll drop a link in #docs after this thread.
Aisha (new-hire): perfect — filing the form now. Thanks everyone for the quick help! :pray:
Marco (eng-infra): welcome aboard Aisha — ping if anything else blocks you.
Sam (sre): marking this thread resolved from SRE side. :white_check_mark:
